violated_contract: A rule that lengthens a deadline from optional context must only ever lengthen it: the result is never shorter than the caller's ordinary or user-configured deadline. continuation_timeout returned the time left in a calendar meeting's scheduled window plus grace as the live silence threshold even when that was shorter than the ordinary 120 seconds or the user's silence setting. A calendar-backed conversation still talking just after its scheduled end was split at the end plus two minutes, and a 10-minute or 4-hour silence setting was cut down to the meeting window.
canonical_prevention: Combine the extension with the caller's deadline as a floor (max of the two) inside the one shared helper that the lifecycle loop, reconnect admission and continuation-pointer lookup all call, so no caller can apply the window as a cap. Tests pin speech after the scheduled end and longer user settings at the helper and through the live lifecycle loop.
